title: Quickstart gallery: compact model selector + live request builder screenshots
creator: Aisha Bryant
description: Goal: Produce a compact set of high-fidelity screenshots and micro-animations for the Hosted API getting-started flow that can be used in the docs quickstart, in-app onboarding, and marketing snippets. Scope: 1) Model selector compact tile (desktop + mobile widths), 2) Live request builder flow (fill form -> run -> streaming response), 3) Side-by-side code snippets for curl + JavaScript + Python, 4) One short GIF demonstrating streaming tokens. Deliverables: PNGs at 2x for each screen size, SVG export for vector UI elements, a 6-second GIF, and a Figma file with component variants and copy-ready notes. Accessibility: ensure color contrast for model badges and keyboard focus shown for the request builder. Alignment: follow Console theme tokens and use real sample model names from model-catalog. Do not reuse existing quickstart screenshots; this set should be more compact and friendly for small viewport placements.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots exported at 2x and 1x for desktop and mobile
Code snippet images match Console syntax theme and copy exactly to clipboard in docs build
GIF demonstrates token-by-token streaming and is under 2MB after optimization
Figma file includes component-level variants and developer notes for copy and asset export
PM and Engineering sign-off on model names and sample request defaults
